info: Version 8.39.0 rebuilds Tax & CSV export with complete history, fiat values and templates for popular tax tools, brings KNS names, KRC-20 token discovery, UTXO consolidation and Ledger support to Kaspa, lets you delete a FluxNode and free its collateral without a transaction, replaces the node maps with a faster built-in map, and adds InstaSwap as a swap provider.
bugs: Ledger and Hardware Wallets: Since 8.38.0, every Ledger send showed 'Unknown error' while the device was still waiting for your approval, and a Ledger could get stuck on 'Loading device…'. Sends now wait for the device, and the wizard notices an app you open on the device after it started. Swap, Sell, Earn, WalletConnect, Sign Message and other actions a hardware wallet cannot sign are now hidden or refused with a clear message, instead of failing part-way or creating an exchange order first.

Swaps, Payments and Saving: Swap Now and the Fusion deposit now ask for your d2FA PIN before signing, the same as Send, if you have d2FA enabled. Starting a second payment while the 'Transaction Sent!' window was open left an empty send form. It now fills the form. A change made within 10 seconds of an earlier save could be lost, for example when you closed the app right after it. These changes are now saved.

Cardano, Polkadot, Kusama and Beldex: A Cardano token send from a wallet that holds other tokens could be refused by the network, and leftover tokens could be left out. The minimum ADA is now priced at the current network rate, and leftover tokens come back to you as change. Polkadot and Kusama history failed to load with 'Error while obtaining Polkadot transactions'. It loads again. OpenAlias names that point to a Beldex integrated address or subaddress now validate.

Kaspa History: Transactions the network never accepted were shown as successful. They now show as pending or failed. KRC-20 token screens, which always showed an empty history, now list their transfers, and the KAS balance updates right after a KRC-20 send. After switching accounts, the next account no longer sees the previous account's Kasplex indexer warning or KCC token status. On the Igra bridge, an amount equal to your whole KAS balance was accepted and then failed with a generic error. The form now keeps 0.05 KAS back for the fee, the same as the Max button.

Ergo and FluxDrive: In a Flux on Ergo claim, a private key that did not match the Ergo address is now refused at step two instead of failing when the claim is sent. Closing the app during an Ergo token consolidation no longer lets the app offer a second one, which the network rejects. Reopening the FluxDrive plans window after paying could start a new payment and strand the first one. A payment sent in the last 2 hours is now picked up again, and the window waits for it to be credited. A server error after a payment was sent no longer brings the Pay button back, since the first payment may already be on its way.

Earn, Toggles, Dropdowns and Accounts: The Actions column of the Earn positions table now stays visible on narrow screens, so unstake, withdraw and redeem can always be reached. Some switches, such as those in Earn, had a second knob drawn over them. In the night theme, text behind an open dropdown list showed through it. Deleting an account while a full node was running only logged you out, and the account stayed. It is now deleted once the node stops.

Horizen: The ZEN balance and history no longer loaded, because the old ZEN explorers now show the Base network. They load again from Horizen's legacy explorer. Horizen's mainchain stopped at block 1,807,300 when ZEN moved to Base, so sending ZEN from the mainchain wallet is now disabled. ZEN on Base is listed as Horizen BASE Token.
Various UI/UX improvements and stability fixes
Performance optimizations and general bug fixes
features: Tax & CSV Export: One export for every coin. Open it from the Export CSV button on a coin's screen or from Tax & CSV export in the wallet menu. Pick the wallets, coins and period, then save one combined file or one file per coin. The dialog lists every server it will contact before it starts, and an encrypted cache on your device makes repeat exports read only what is new.

Templates and Custom Mappings: Ready-made layouts for Koinly, CoinTracker, CoinLedger, CoinTracking, Blockpit, ZenLedger, TokenTax and eleven more tax tools, plus neutral and accountant layouts. Save as CSV, XLSX or JSON. To build your own layout, add, reorder and rename columns and set the date format, timezone, decimal separator and sign convention. A preview shows your own history, and mappings can be saved, exported and imported. For tax tools that sync by address, export or copy a list of your public wallet addresses. It never contains keys.

Complete History with Fiat Values: The export reads each address's history to the end, where the old export stopped after one page or a fixed number of rows on many chains. Fees are counted for the wallet that paid them, failed transactions keep their fee without an amount, and both sides of a swap are written out. Every row is valued from full price history. Rows ZelCore cannot price or classify are flagged, never dropped and never valued at 0. Prices are only fetched when the chosen layout has fiat or price columns. Cosmos Hub, Osmosis, Cardano, Sui and BNB Beacon Chain can now be exported. Retired coins such as Fantom Opera and VeriBlock have no history source left and cannot be exported. Their coin screen tells you why. The ZelCore classic layout has new columns, and a transfer between your own addresses shows only its fee.

Kaspa Names and Tools: Send KAS and KRC-20 tokens to a KNS name such as alice.kas. The address it resolves to is shown under the name. A mistyped or wrong-network Kaspa address is flagged as you type. Merge many small UTXOs with Consolidate UTXOs on the KAS screen, see older transactions with Load More, see incoming payments within seconds while the coin screen is open, and sign messages with your Kaspa address. The fee shown for a Kaspa send is the fee charged.

Kaspa Tokens and iKAS: KRC-20 tokens your wallet holds are found and listed under Imported Kaspa Tokens in Add Assets, and a ticker is checked before you import it. A transfer that was interrupted can be completed from the coin screen, so its 0.3 KAS deposit is no longer stuck. KRC-20 sends pause while the Kasplex indexer is down. Kaspa covenant tokens (KRON and KCC-20) are found and shown with their balance, supply and history, but they are view-only for now. The Igra bridge can now move iKAS back to KAS. The KAS typically arrives within 48–72 hours.

Ledger and Hardware Wallets: Import a Kaspa address from a Ledger device and send KAS with it. KRC-20 tokens on Ledger are not supported yet. Hardware Wallet now appears in the import menu without the Experimental label. Trezor still needs experimental features turned on.

FluxNodes: Deleting a node frees its collateral at once, with no transaction, and the node stays deleted after restarts and logins. A deleted node's unspent collateral is listed under Available to lock, with a Lock button. The Fluxnodes and Firo maps are rebuilt. They have no watermarks, follow the night or light theme, zoom smoothly, open at once from the last saved data, and can show only your nodes, including new ones the network list does not show yet.

Flux on Ergo to Flux Main Chain: In Fusion, FLUX-ERG holders at Ergo block 1,878,291 can claim 1:1 to a Flux address with the new migration option, with no fee. Existing Flux on Ergo claims now pay out on the Flux main chain.

InstaSwap and Swap Badges: InstaSwap is now a swap provider, in three forms: InstaSwap routes your swap through decentralized exchanges, InstaSwap Private makes the deposit and payout impossible to link on-chain, and InstaSwap ZK settles through a zero-knowledge shielded pool. Swap offers show DEX, Private and ZK badges, with a legend that explains each one, including that a ZK swap can take more than an hour.

CumulusVPN, Languages and Lighter Startup: CumulusVPN joins FluxDrive and the other Flux network apps in Apps. All 18 languages cover every screen again, with about 27,000 missing translations added and about 5,000 corrected. ZelCore also loads less than half as much code at launch. Code for Veil, Polkadot, Monero, Cardano and Ergo loads the first time you use those chains.
